description: This file defines an abstract base class for vision services within a larger AI framework. It incorporates methods for processing image frames, particularly focusing on analysis via vision models, and integrates with metrics tracking. The class is designed to be extended by subclasses that implement specific vision functionalities such as image captioning or visual question answering.

classes.name: VisionService
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for vision-related AI services that analyze images and generate textual outputs. It manages frame processing, extends an AIService, and enforces implementation of the core vision processing method.

methods.name: __init__(self, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the VisionService object, calling the parent constructor and setting up internal variables.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_vision(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame)
methods.description: An abstract method that subclasses must implement to process an image frame and yield analysis results, such as descriptions or answers.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles incoming frames, invoking vision analysis for UserImageRawFrame instances with text, and manages metrics tracking.
